name: Letterboxd

themes.label: Ad Overload/Intrusiveness
themes.describe: Users complain about the frequency, type (video/full-screen), and general annoyance of advertisements.

quotes.title: Unskippable ads fr?
quotes.text: Added unskippable video ads to the landing page that directly inhibits using the product as designed.

quotes.title: Too many ads
quotes.text: I had an account but it lasted 1 minute. I’m autistic and cannot stand ads. They distress me deeply. This app is littered with them and quite honestly, not a good app. I don’t get the hype. …

quotes.title: Was Great
quotes.text: I love watching movies, so Letterboxd was a fun way to track them and record my opinions. They have recently started “Letterboxd pro,” before that the ads were subtle and sometimes helpful. …

brief.headline: Increase in reports of intrusive advertisement formats
brief.happening: Users are reporting a rise in unskippable, full-screen, and video advertisements. These ads are described as disruptive to the core experience, particularly when appearing during app launch or while posting reviews.
brief.where_to_look: The app launch sequence and the movie logging flow.
brief.action: Review the frequency and placement of full-screen video ad units in recent builds.
brief.reply: Thank you for being a part of the Letterboxd community. We are sorry to hear that the recent changes to our ad experience have impacted your enjoyment of the app. We appreciate your feedback regarding the visibility of ads and will share this with our product team.

requests.request: Remove unskippable video ads upon opening the app
requests.quote: Added unskippable video ads to the landing page that directly inhibits using the product as designed.

requests.request: Stop full screen pop up ads from covering display
requests.quote: I couldn't stand the sheer amount of ads: full screen pop ups, floating video players, embedded ads that float on scroll - and all of them with jarring visual movement …

requests.request: Stop ads from obstructing screen or blocking lists
requests.quote: I understand having ads but why do you have one that’s literally in the way and cannot be cancelled out of the screen? It literally blocks my list.

requests.request: Remove ads that trigger when posting reviews
requests.quote: … If you don’t pay them they will force you to watch a commercial when you press POST on your movie review.

actions.direction: Prioritize reducing ad intrusiveness by addressing unskippable video ads upon app launch and full-screen pop-ups, as these represent the largest share of specific complaints.
actions.outcome: Users will experience fewer interruptions to their app navigation and content viewing.
actions.check: The share of reviews mentioning unskippable video ads and full-screen pop-ups should decrease in subsequent releases.

themes.label: Poor User Experience (UX)
themes.describe: Complaints regarding confusing navigation, clunky interfaces, or poor design elements.

quotes.title: No iPhone Duo support!
quotes.text: This app is begging for iPhone Duo support. Everything is so small on the outer screen and the inner screen view is laughable.

quotes.title: No duo support
quotes.text: It’s a shame having to leave a negative review, but as a patron user, I really thought that full iPhone Duo support would be optimised by now. …

quotes.title: Turn off the top left animation!! It’s ANNOYING!!
quotes.text: I don’t like the corner animation. Every time I refresh, it returns. It’s even on the website. The unnecessary motion is an accessibility issue! I don’t like it. Pls REMOVE IT!!!

brief.headline: Navigation and display scaling concerns
brief.happening: Users report difficulty navigating the interface and finding specific sections like likes or following. There are also recurring reports regarding poor scaling and lack of support for iPhone Duo displays.
brief.where_to_look: The display scaling logic for foldable devices and the navigation menu structure.
brief.action: Review the recent impact of UI animations and audio behavior on app stability.
brief.reply: Thank you for sharing this feedback. We understand that the refresh animation can be disruptive, and we appreciate you highlighting this as an accessibility concern. Please feel free to reach out to our support team to share more details.

requests.request: Add native support and scaling for iPhone Duo
requests.quote: … Please add native support for iPhone Duo with proper scaling.

requests.request: Stop the app from taking control of phone audio
requests.quote: I can’t listen to audiobooks or music never whenever I open this app, it takes control of my phone’s audio and stops it. Annoying!

requests.request: Reduce frequency or size of ads
requests.quote: Been using this app for a few years no issues whatsoever works fine however recently there was a new update and it changes the way as presented. I used to be able to …

requests.request: Remove the top left corner animation
requests.quote: I don’t like the corner animation. Every time I refresh, it returns. It’s even on the website. The unnecessary motion is an accessibility issue! I don’t like it. Pls …

actions.direction: Prioritize implementing native support and scaling for iPhone Duo and addressing the issue of the app taking control of phone audio. These two requests represent the largest share of actionable feedback.
actions.outcome: Users will have a more seamless experience on foldable devices and more control over their device's audio playback.
actions.check: The share of reviews mentioning iPhone Duo scaling and audio control should decrease in subsequent releases.

themes.label: Stability & Bugs
themes.describe: Frequent reports of the app crashing, freezing, or failing to load properly.

brief.headline: Stability and performance issues in recent app versions
brief.happening: Users are reporting frequent app crashes, long loading times, and content loading failures. Specific reports also mention video streaming interruptions and device overheating during use.
brief.where_to_look: The video playback and streaming functionality.
brief.action: Review recent crash logs and performance metrics for v4.13.10 and v4.13.12.
brief.reply: We are sorry to hear about the connection issues you experienced while watching. We want the video store to be a seamless experience for you. Please reach out to our support team so we can look into this further.

requests.request: Fix video store streaming interruptions and buffering
requests.quote: STREAMING CONSTANTLY INTERRUPTED WITH BUFFERING/LATENCY ISSUES. WHAT AN EMBARRASSMENT FOR THE ARTISTS WHO RELY ON THIS PLATFORM TO SHOWCASE THEIR WORK. FIX …

requests.request: Prevent phone overheating when using the app

requests.request: Prevent app from erasing logged movie reviews

actions.direction: Start with the most-asked change: fix video store streaming interruptions and buffering (2 of 7 reviews).
actions.outcome: Fewer reviews raising this problem after the release that ships it.
actions.check: Watch this complaint's share of reviews in the next release on the "Did the fix work?" chart.

brief.headline: Decreasing reports of login and session sync issues
brief.happening: A small minority of recent reviews mention being randomly logged out or unable to sign in. Users have reported losing access to lists and reviews after being signed out unexpectedly.
brief.where_to_look: The authentication flow and session persistence during active app use.
brief.action: Review recent error logs related to session timeouts and account creation failures.
brief.reply: We are sorry to hear you're having trouble creating an account. Please reach out to our support team so we can look into this further and help you get started with Letterboxd.

requests.request: Fix account creation and login failures
requests.quote: … I kept my login info so it’s not me. I tried to verify and it’s “too late”. That’s ridiculous how can I not verify it now? Also I tried resetting the password and it …

requests.request: Prevent random sign-outs and session timeouts

actions.direction: Prioritize fixing account creation and login failures, followed by addressing random sign-outs and session timeouts, to stabilize core user access.
actions.outcome: Users should be able to create accounts and remain logged in without unexpected session interruptions.
actions.check: The share of reviews mentioning login failures and random sign-outs should decrease relative to the total number of reviews.

brief.headline: Feature Gaps/Enhancements: raised mostly in happy reviews
brief.happening: Of the 26 reviews in the last 90 days that raise this, 21 are 4–5 stars and 1 is 1–2 stars: it comes up mostly as a request or a side note from people who like the app. The evidence below shows the unhappy one.
brief.where_to_look: The mobile app feature parity with the web browser.
brief.action: Review the feasibility of bringing web-only toggles to the mobile interface.
brief.reply: Thank you for being a paid member and for sharing this feedback. We understand how important the 'where to watch' toggle is for your mobile experience. We appreciate you bringing this to our attention, and please feel free to reach out to our support team with any other thoughts.

actions.direction: Prioritize adding TV shows and series to the app to address the most frequent specific feature request.

world.note: The most recent reviews (up to 100) in each country's App Store, read through the iTunes store's review endpoint and tagged with the same themes as the English analysis above, which they don't change.

callout: The store shows 4.82★; people who take the time to write average 2.91★. The loudest day in six months was 9 Aug: 23 reviews in one day on v4.12.3, mostly Login & Sync Issues, and a three-report alert would have fired at 06:25 Pacific.
